meaning:
§ Massah = "temptation"
the place in the wilderness where the Israelites tested Jehovah
also 'Meribah'

elsewhere.note: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested Yahweh, saying, “Is Yahweh among us, or…
You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
